video_title: My toddler is up at 5 am and ready for the day: what to do
caption:
My toddler is up at 5 am and ready for the day.

A steady wake time, even on weekends, helps children aged 1-5 years feel secure.
Skip long afternoon naps and add active play and fresh air.
Greet the morning with bright daylight to help reset the body clock.
